content.description: Camshaft timing pulleys showing EX side and IN side with guide positioning

content.text: (b) Install the camshaft timing pulleys with the guides facing the directions indicated below.
EX side ....... With the pulley guide facing the No. 2 timing belt cover side
IN side ........ With the pulley guide facing the front side

content.description: Alignment of matchmarks on timing belt cover and camshaft/crankshaft pulleys

content.text: (c) Align the matchmarks of the No. 2 timing belt cover with those of the camshaft timing pulleys and of the crankshaft pulley.
Make sure that the No. 1 cylinder is set to TDC/compression.

content.description: Timing belt installation showing tension between crankshaft and camshaft pulleys

content.text: (d) Install the timing belt with the belt having no tension between the crankshaft timing pulley and the camshaft timing pulley on the exhaust side.
Install the timing belt while the engine is cold.

content.description: Idler pulley set bolt loosening and timing belt stretching at points A and B

content.text: (e) Loosen the idler pulley set bolt and stretch the timing belt. Torque the idler pulley set bolt.
Make sure that the timing belt tension at A is equal to that at B.

content.description: Camshaft pulley showing three overlapped pin holes for adjustment

content.text: (f) There are three pin holes on the camshaft and timing pulleys.
Select one overlapped hole and insert the pin into it.
• When inserting a pin into a hole, find one that is nearly overlapped and rotate the crankshaft slightly to overlap it and insert the pin.
• The crankshaft pulley angle can be adjusted approximately 3° by changing the pin hole to the next one.
